messages:
maya: Quick alert 1: Acme, ClearHealth, and StudyBox reported partial search hits after bulk embedding ingest. Some documents are missing from their indexes; Acme noted renewal concerns.

omar: Any idea root cause? Need a short status to send to customers and renewal team.

john: We traced it to a deduplication change merged yesterday. When payloads exceeded ~2MB, the dedupe routine incorrectly dropped chunks. Rolling back to the previous pipeline commit now. ETA ~30	60m including sanity checks.

sarah: Can someone author a clear customer note with remediation steps, fallback options, and an office-hours invite? Keep tone apologetic but concise.

maya: Draft to review:

```
Hi <Customer>,

We're investigating an issue affecting document ingestion for embeddings that may cause some documents to be omitted from search results. Our engineering team has identified the root cause (a recent dedupe change) and is rolling back the change to restore full indexing. Expected recovery window: 2	3 hours. We'll confirm once your index is fully verified.

Temporary mitigation: we can run a manual re-index for your tenant immediately (no charge). If you have live queries, consider switching to the legacy embeddings model (embeddings-v1-legacy) as a short-term fallback.

We sincerely apologize for the disruption. A more detailed RCA will be provided within 24 hours.

 Redwood Inference Customer Success
```

omar: Nice. Add a line offering a one-time service credit if re-indexing exceeds our SLA window; loop in renewal rep.

john: Rollback completed. Verifying sample indices for the three tenants. ClearHealth and StudyBox samples look good. Acme has very large bulk files; starting prioritized re-index job now. Est finish ~90m.

sarah: Comms plan: send "resolved, verifying" note to ClearHealth and StudyBox now. For Acme: "re-index prioritized, office hours scheduled, renewal rep looped." Assignments: john = verify + re-index; sarah = send emails + office-hours invite; omar = renewal rep escalation and credit proposal; maya = compile RCA draft.

john: Re-index running for Acme; no evidence of data loss, only dropped chunks due to size threshold. Monitoring progress.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1887654321  embeddings-ingest-dedupe. Severity P2. Owner: john. Affected: 3 tenants. RCA due within 24h.

maya: Action items captured. Sarah, confirm customer replies are tracked in the ticket and share any asks from Acme's success team. Omar, please set credit threshold and draft language for the renewal rep.

sarah: Emails queued and sent. Office hours scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT; invites include success contacts and renewal rep for Acme.

omar: On it. I'll prepare a provisional credit offer and flag potential revenue impact if this delays Acme's renewal.

maya: We'll collect feedback during office hours and convert any product gaps into infra/product tickets (esp. max payload handling + dedupe behavior). RCA draft target in 12h, final customer update when Acme is verified. :white_check_mark:

john: ClearHealth and StudyBox verified green. Acme re-index ~60% complete; will update when finished.

maya: Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with any customer responses or new symptoms.
